BILL NUMBER:  S5393

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the local finance law, in relation to the
establishment of an electronic public bond sale pilot program for
Westchester county; and providing for the repeal of such provisions
upon the expiration thereof


 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :
To allow Westchester County to establish a pilot program to assess the
potential advantages of selling public bonds via nationally recognized
electronic securities bidding platforms.

THE CURRENT LAW: Currently Westchester County must conduct the sale of
public bonds via paper bids.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :
Section I amends the local finance law by adding a new' section,
58.10. Paragraph a establishes an electronic public bond sale pilot
program for the county of Westchester. Paragraph b provides that
electronic bidding will be conducted through certain nationally
recognized electronic securities bidding services, and may be used for
both open and closed auctions, and provides the definition of an open
auction. Paragraph c states that, with certain exceptions, where the
notice of sale has specified that bids will only be accepted
electronically, the county shall not be obligated to receive paper
bids.  Paragraph d provides that the program shall be administered by
the County's chief fiscal officer, provides requirements for
publishing its program policy and procedure, and stipulates how the
program shall comply with existing laws, rules and regulations.
Paragraph e provides that the County's chief fiscal officer shall
review the program to ensure functionality and profitability, and
provides certain procedures and requirements for the program's
evaluation.

Section 2 provides the effective and expiration dates.

 JUSTIFICATION :
Electronic bidding processes have been recognized to increase the
speed and efficiency of bidding as well as reduce the administrative
burden and costs of the paper bidding process. This bill will thus
enhance the efficiency and profitability of Westchester County's sale
of public bonds by allowing them to conduct such sales electronically,
and will further enhance this process for the County by allowing them
to take advantage of the latest advances in internet bidding platforms
operated by nationally recognized electronic securities bidding firms.
Currently, ten states, including New Jersey, Ohio and Texas, have
enacted legislation that allow municipalities to conduct public bond
sales through these nationally recognized bidding firms.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
A11365-A, 2008 referred to rules. Same as S7966-A, passed senate.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None to the State and potentially positive to local government.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.

summary: Establishes a pilot program in Westchester county authorizing the county to sell bonds through electronic securities bidding services; defines open auction and closed auction; the county shall conduct evaluations of the pilot program annually and provide a summary at the end of three years.
